mentions.name: Prompt injection benchmark
mentions.description: This blog post introduces a benchmark for prompt injection, the problem where LLMs cannot reliably distinguish a user's instructions from untrusted content such as web search results.
mentions.problem: LLMs can't reliably distinguish between the user's instructions and untrusted content like web search results.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on _prompt injection_, the problem where LLMs can't reliably distinguish between the user's instructions and untrusted content like web search results.

Just published a blog post a few minutes ago: https://alexcbecker.net/blog/prompt-injection-benchmark.html
